The '''palace''' in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Livien Magnus]] was the central government building of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. It was seized by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Battle of Ord Radama]] in [[3660 BBY]].<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side" />
